$comment: The selected-work page, in this order. Every frame here appears on /featured-work; nothing else does. Add, remove and reorder freely. path is relative to src/images/Portfolios at the repository root. caption is yours to write, in the AP style used by the journalism sidecars: who, what, where, when, then credit. An empty caption is allowed and the generator warns about it; a path that does not resolve fails the build. album is the gallery route the frame came from, or an empty string for no link. Add an optional alt only when the photograph needs describing beyond what the caption already says, because a caption and an alt that repeat each other are read out twice.

frames.title: Protest near Carnegie Mellon
frames.caption: A demonstrator stands near Pittsburgh police in riot gear during a protest in the Oakland neighborhood of Pittsburgh, Pa., July 15, 2025. Demonstrators marched against the Pennsylvania Energy and Innovation Summit at Carnegie Mellon University, where President Donald Trump announced $92 billion in energy and artificial intelligence investments in the state. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

frames.path: Journalism/Politics/trump-returns-butler/051024 Caleb McCartney_Trump Returns to Butler PA_CAL2494.webp
frames.title: Trump Returns to Butler
frames.caption: A supporter wears an ear bandage reading “Fight! Fight! Fight!” before former President Donald Trump's rally at the Butler Farm Show fairgrounds in Butler, Pa., Oct. 5, 2024. Trump returned to the site where a gunman grazed his ear on July 13, and where he raised his fist and repeated the phrase as agents pulled him from the stage. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

frames.path: Journalism/Events/Pro Palestine Protest at Pitt/240430_Pro Palestine Protest at Pitt_CAL1501_webuse.jpg
frames.title: Pro-Palestinian Protest at Pitt
frames.caption: Demonstrators gather during a pro-Palestinian protest at the University of Pittsburgh in Pittsburgh, Pa., April 28, 2024. Pittsburgh police moved protesters off the university's lawn that evening and two people were charged with trespassing. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

frames.title: Trump Rally, Erie
frames.caption: A supporter dressed as Uncle Sam wheels a larger-than-life cutout of former President Donald Trump past vendor tents before his rally at the Bayfront Convention Center in Erie, Pa., Sept. 29, 2024. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

frames.title: Tim Walz Rally, Erie
frames.caption: Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz, the Democratic vice presidential nominee, greets supporters at a campaign rally at Highmark Amphitheater in Erie, Pa., Sept. 5, 2024. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

frames.title: Harris Arrives in Johnstown
frames.caption: Vice President Kamala Harris greets onlookers on the tarmac after arriving on Air Force Two at John Murtha Johnstown-Cambria County Airport in Johnstown, Pa., Sept. 13, 2024. More than 400 invited guests met her at the airport before she continued to downtown Johnstown. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

frames.title: Election Eve, Rankin
frames.caption: Vice President Kamala Harris waits in the wings as supporters raise signs during a campaign rally at the Carrie Blast Furnaces National Historic Landmark in Rankin, Pa., Nov. 4, 2024. The rally on the eve of the election drew about 15,000 people. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

frames.title: Harris Rally, Erie
frames.caption: Supporters watch from the stands, behind red, white and blue bunting, during a campaign rally with Vice President Kamala Harris at Erie Insurance Arena in Erie, Pa., Oct. 14, 2024. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)

frames.title: JD Vance Rally, Johnstown
frames.caption: Supporters raise their hands as Republican vice presidential nominee JD Vance speaks at a campaign rally at JWF Industries in Johnstown, Pa., Oct. 12, 2024. (Photo by Caleb McCartney)
